celadonsoft-dev.desc: I developed applications based on customer needs using technologies such as React, React Native, TypeScript, and Redux. In this role, we also refactored the SellItBack application to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability. Additionally, I developed the admin panel of the 12Reps project using React.

erciyes.desc: As part of the Young Talent program, I migrated the patch distribution service of the holding and its group companies from Desktop Central to Microsoft Intune. I also gained knowledge in virtualization.

celadonsoft-intern.desc: During my internship, I developed a MERN-based Library (BookStore) project using Node.js, React, and MongoDB. I also created a clone of the PragueCoolPass website with React, and built an online TicTacToe game playable on a 3D cube.

market-calculus.desc: During my internship, I learned version control systems, TypeScript, and Jira. Later, I joined an ongoing React project and integrated the drag-and-drop features assigned to me into the company's production environment.
